ok.description: In this photo, a red dot with a white ring marks one spot. The area shaded with a cyan edge is someone's outline of the thing the red dot is on: the object it is on or, if the dot is on a background or a surface, that region. Is the outline correct: does it cover the thing the red dot is on, most of it, and not much else?

verdict.description: In this photo, a red dot with a white ring marks one spot. The area shaded with a cyan edge is someone's outline of the thing the red dot is on: the object it is on or, if the dot is on a background or a surface, that region. What best describes the outline?

anyOf.description: It outlines the thing the red dot is on, closely.
It is on the thing the red dot is on, but misses a large part of it or spills well beyond it.
It outlines something else, not the thing the red dot is on.
It is not the shape of any one thing: zigzags or scrambled lines.
